units.source_text: 此时月出较迟，便命各处点起灯笼，使火光明暗适度。

en.t: At this time the moon rose late, so he ordered lanterns to be lit everywhere, making the brightness of the firelight just right.

units.source_text: 源氏向三公主窥看，但见她比别人娇小可爱，似觉只看见衣裳。

en.t: Genji stole a glance at the Third Princess and saw that she was smaller and more charming than the others, so slight that it seemed he could see only her robes.

units.source_text: 此人缺乏艳丽之相，只觉高贵秀美，好比二月中旬的新柳，略展鹅黄，而柔弱不胜莺飞。

en.t: She lacked a dazzling beauty, but seemed noble and graceful, like a fresh willow in mid February, just showing a hint of tender yellow and too delicate even to bear a warbler's flight.

units.source_text: 她身穿一件白面红里的常礼服，头发从左右两旁挂向前面，很像青青的柳丝。

en.t: She wore an ordinary formal robe with a white outside and red lining, and her hair hung forward from both sides, very much like green willow strands.

units.source_text: 这正是高贵无比的公主模样。

en.t: This was precisely the appearance of an incomparably noble princess.

units.source_text: 明石女御容姿与三公主一样优雅，而艳丽之相较多。

en.t: The Akashi Consort was as elegant in appearance as the Third Princess, but had more brilliance and sensual charm.

units.source_text: 举止端详，气品高贵，好比盛开的藤花，当夏日群花零落之后，独自在晨光中开颜发艳。

en.t: Her bearing was calm and dignified, her air noble, like blooming wisteria that, after the summer flowers have fallen, opens alone in the morning light with radiant color.

units.source_text: 但她现正怀孕，腹部显然膨胀。

en.t: But she was now pregnant, and her belly was plainly swollen.

units.source_text: 演奏之后颇感困顿，把筝推向一旁，一手靠在矮几上了。

en.t: After the performance she felt rather exhausted, pushed the koto aside, and rested one hand on a low armrest.

units.source_text: 她的身材矮小纤弱，而矮几是普通大小的，因此她的手臂必须提高，样子很不舒服。

en.t: Because her figure was small and frail while the armrest was of ordinary size, she had to raise her arm, making her posture look very uncomfortable.

units.source_text: 源氏便想替她特制一个较小的矮几，可见对她关怀无微不至。

en.t: Genji therefore thought of having a smaller armrest specially made for her, showing how attentive he was to every detail of her comfort.

units.source_text: 她身穿红面紫里的外衣，头发长长地挂下去，十分清整，灯光之下的姿态美丽绝伦。

en.t: She wore an outer robe red on the outside and purple within; her long hair hung down neatly, and her figure in the lamplight was matchlessly beautiful.

units.source_text: 紫夫人穿的大约是淡紫色的外衣、深色的礼服和淡胭脂色的无襟服，

en.t: Lady Murasaki seemed to be wearing a pale purple outer robe, a dark formal robe, and a light rouge colored uncollared garment,

units.source_text: 头发异常浓密，柔顺地堆压在肩背上，和身材大小恰好相称，但觉全身十分匀称美满。

en.t: her hair was exceptionally thick and lay softly over her shoulders and back, perfectly matched to her build, so that her whole figure seemed beautifully balanced and complete.

units.source_text: 若要用花来比方，可说是春天的樱花，然而比樱花更加优美，这容颜实在是特殊的。

en.t: If one were to compare her to a flower, she might be called a spring cherry blossom, yet she was even more beautiful than cherry blossoms; her face was truly extraordinary.

units.source_text: 明石夫人夹在这些高贵的妇人中，想必会相形见绌，但事实并不如此。

en.t: One might expect Lady Akashi, among these noble women, to suffer by comparison, but in fact this was not so.

units.source_text: 她的举止态度非常优雅，令人看了觉得自惭。

en.t: Her manner and bearing were so graceful that anyone who saw her felt ashamed of themselves.

units.source_text: 气度之悠闲与容貌之妩媚，不可言喻。

en.t: The ease of her bearing and the charm of her beauty were beyond words.

units.source_text: 身穿柳绿色织锦的无襟服、近似淡绿的礼服，外面拴着轻罗围裙，借以表示谦逊。

en.t: She wore a willow green brocade uncollared garment and a formal robe close to pale green, with a light gauze skirt tied outside to show humility.

units.source_text: 然而人皆对她怀着好感，绝无轻侮之意。

en.t: Yet everyone felt goodwill toward her and had not the slightest thought of looking down on her.

units.source_text: 她偏斜地坐在一条青色高丽锦镶边的茵褥上，一手扶着琵琶，

en.t: She sat slightly sideways on a cushion edged with blue Korean brocade, supporting a biwa with one hand,

units.source_text: 另一手以美妙的姿势拿着拨子，其神情之优雅，令人觉得“此时无声胜有声”。

en.t: while the other hand held the plectrum in a beautiful pose; the elegance of her expression made one feel that silence at this moment surpassed sound.

units.source_text: 看到这人，好像闻到五月橘连花带实的折枝的香气。

en.t: Looking at her was like smelling the fragrance of a May orange branch broken off with both blossoms and fruit attached.

units.source_text: 各位夫人斯文一脉地坐在帘内，夕雾大将在帘外听到她们的动静，

en.t: The ladies all sat with refined grace inside the blinds, while Commander Yugiri, outside the blinds, heard their movements,

units.source_text: 并隐约窥见人影，不免心驰神往。

en.t: and as he faintly glimpsed their shadows, his heart could not help being carried away.

units.source_text: 他想象紫夫人年龄既长，一定比从前朔风那天朝晨窥见的模样更加美丽了，

en.t: He imagined that Lady Murasaki, now older, must be even more beautiful than when he had glimpsed her long ago on that north wind morning,

units.source_text: 便觉心痒难搔。

en.t: and the thought left him restless with longing.

units.source_text: 又想：“三公主和我的宿缘若得更深些，我早就可将她占为己有。

en.t: He also thought, "If the destined bond between the Third Princess and me had been deeper, I could long ago have made her mine.

units.source_text: 只恨我当时缺乏勇气，实甚可惜。

en.t: I only regret that I lacked courage then; it was truly a great pity.

units.source_text: 朱雀院不是屡次当面向我示意，并且背后也常提起我么？”

en.t: Did not the Suzaku院 hint to me many times in person, and often mention me behind the scenes as well?"

units.source_text: 他觉得后悔莫及。

en.t: He felt that his regret was beyond repair.

units.source_text: 然而并非看见三公主态度无拘无束而想侮辱她。

en.t: Yet it was not because he had seen the Third Princess behave freely and unguardedly that he wished to insult her.

units.source_text: 他对三公主并不十分动心。

en.t: He was not especially moved by the Third Princess.

units.source_text: 只是对于紫夫人，觉得在任何方面说来，都高不可攀，因此多年以来一直无法接近她。

en.t: It was only Lady Murasaki whom he felt to be unattainably lofty in every respect, and for that reason he had been unable to approach her for many years.

units.source_text: 他想：“至少总得设法使她知道我对她的好意。”

en.t: He thought, "At the very least, I must somehow make her know my good feelings toward her."

units.source_text: 为此烦闷悲叹。

en.t: Because of this, he was troubled and sorrowful.

units.source_text: 但他决不怀有狂妄越礼之心，态度总是谨慎小心的。

en.t: But he never harbored any arrogant or improper intention, and his conduct was always cautious and restrained.
